The regulator found that REL inflated its revenue by booking personal gold trades as corporate sales and using funds from the company to benefit the promoter.  **REL** denies these allegations, claiming confusion with Valcambi SA's Ebitda figures. Sebi also criticized the company's auditors for not providing necessary documents and statements during their investigation. The company's market cap was just over ₹3,000 crore as of Thursday.

recent_articles.title: BJP names Rajya Sabha candidates for five States; two Union Ministers left out - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** announced its candidates for the upcoming Rajya Sabha polls in five states.  The party nominated several younger leaders, including Rajubhai Shukla, Mukeshbhai Rathwa, Mansingh Parmar, and Jitendra Meghjibhai Kanzariya from Gujarat; Tarun Chugh and Rajneesh Agrawal from Madhya Pradesh; Alka Gurjar and Satish Poonia from Rajasthan; A. Sharda Devi from Manipur; and Tai Tagak from Arunachal Pradesh.  The party also accommodated Debashish Samantaray, who recently joined the BJP after leaving his seat in the Rajya Sabha as a Biju Janata Dal (BJD) MP. The Rajya Sabha polls will be held on June 18.

recent_articles.title: Cockroach Janata Party attacks govt. on JEE data exposure, presses for Education Minister’s sacking - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Cockroach Janata Party (CJP)** criticized the government's handling of the JEE (Advanced) 2026 results portal data leak, claiming incompetence in cybersecurity and education. CJP spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka demanded Prime Minister Narendra Modi sack Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan for failing to ensure accountability. The incident exposed nearly two lakh student records and prompted IIT Roorkee to acknowledge a cloud storage configuration issue.  Ranka called for transparency regarding data breaches and urged peaceful protests, while the party founder Abhijeet Dipke is expected to arrive in Delhi on June 6th to seek permission for a demonstration at Jantar Mantar.

recent_articles.title: Drum plantation technique helps grow 3,200 trees in saline land at Dholera - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DSIRDA** and the **Gujarat Forest Department** successfully planted over 3,200 trees using a drum plantation technique in saline land at Dholera. The project aimed to increase green cover in the area affected by high soil salinity, low carbon content, and prolonged waterlogging.  The technique involved planting saplings in plastic drums filled with layers of sand, nutrient-rich soil, vermicompost, stubble, and cocopeat, which provided protection from the harsh conditions. The project has resulted in a high survival rate, with some trees already bearing fruit and attracting pollinators and birds.

recent_articles.title: British Foreign Secretary's First Delhi Visit Strengthens India-UK Ties
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yvette Cooper**, **Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs**, concluded a two-day official visit to India, leaving behind agreements that signal the rapid maturation of the bilateral partnership.  Cooper held extensive talks with **Dr S Jaishankar**, External Affairs Minister, and met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, reviewing the five pillars of the India-UK Vision 2035 framework: Growth, Technology and Innovation, Defence and Security, Climate and Clean Energy, and Education. The visit included the handover of a Letter of Approval to the University of Liverpool for its new campus in Bengaluru, an agreement on a Regional Maritime Security Centre for Excellence between King's College London and India's National Maritime Foundation, and the launch of the UK-India Critical Minerals Supply Chain Observatory.  These agreements demonstrate the growing strategic importance of the India-UK relationship.

recent_articles.title: Nepal Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal On 3-Day India Visit To Reset Ties Amid Boundary Row
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shisir Khanal**, **Nepal's Foreign Minister**, arrived in New Delhi for a three-day official visit at the invitation of **External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar**. The visit aims to repair strained diplomatic ties with India following a boundary row and a recent incident where India's Foreign Secretary failed to secure an audience with Nepal's Prime Minister.  **Khanal** will hold talks covering trade, investment, connectivity, energy, and people-to-people ties, signaling Kathmandu's commitment to re-engage New Delhi at the highest levels.

recent_articles.title: "PM Modi A Good Friend": Trump's Big Remark On India-US Trade Deal
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** expressed confidence in reaching a trade agreement with **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, stating that the US will get to a deal because he "likes your prime minister a lot."  Trump accused **India** of taking advantage of US policies for years by charging high tariffs and benefiting unfairly. A US delegation held cooperative trade talks with **India** on an interim bilateral agreement, reaffirming their commitment to concluding a mutually beneficial agreement that strengthens bilateral trade and economic ties. The US also announced additional tariffs on 54 countries alleging forced labor in goods imports.

recent_articles.title: Drive launched to tackle sickle cell anaemia - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **National Commission for Scheduled Tribes (NCST)** is conducting nationwide awareness programs to combat sickle cell anemia, particularly in tribal regions.  **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has prioritized addressing the issue, and the NCST conducted reviews of tribal welfare programs in Andhra Pradesh. The commission's delegation included members Jatothu Hussain and Nirupam Chakma, Secretary Prashant Kumar Singh, and Director P. Kalyan Reddy.

recent_articles.title: Energy tie-up tops India-Venezuela agenda as Modi meets Delcy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** welcomed **Acting President Delcy Rodriguez** of **Venezuela** to India, emphasizing the importance of their partnership for the Global South.  **Rodriguez**, who arrived on Wednesday for a five-day visit, highlighted **energy security** as a key element of the relationship. The visit comes amidst Venezuela's ongoing political transition and economic transformation following President Nicolas Maduro's abduction by the U.S. military in January.
